141-2034-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

243-628-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

618-2438-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

277-3129-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

301-4381-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6968-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1778-2459-2928-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-2459-2928-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1456-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4772-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4772-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

1765-2079-2440-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2079-2440-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

2511-2906-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2511-2906-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

997-2281-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-5060-6707.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
321-399-2475-5060-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5226-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

969-1453-2387-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
969-1453-2387-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2981-4053-6989.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1418-1651-2573-3875-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-2573-3875-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-2573-3875-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

856-5220-5256-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5220-5256-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5220-5256-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

147-3967-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3967-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3967-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

5572-6249-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5572-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

56-792-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-792-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Totentanz trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-792-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2292-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2292-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

1617-3455-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Vizier of Many Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3455-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Vizier of Many Faces to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-3967-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-3967-5434.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

215-1336-2635.notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand with mana value equal to seven.
Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, minus {1}.
215-1336-2635.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Heronblade Elite's power.
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana value seven by paying its mana cost.
Raggadragga's second ability triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the green creature with mana value seven from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

515-1636-2026.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

2034-3121-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Servos, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the tokens die, Marionette Master triggers twice, causing target opponent to lose life equal to twice Marionette Master's power.
Repeat.

1309-1964-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1309-1964-1987-3075.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
